reason: A vision integration plugin that delegates image analysis to configured external multimodal providers and returns the analysis as text to the current DeepSeek Harness conversation.

summaries.zh: 将图片发送至配置的外部多模态模型进行分析，并把结果以文本形式返回到当前 DeepSeek Harness 对话中。
summaries.en: Delegates image analysis to a configured external multimodal provider and returns the result as text in the current DeepSeek Harness conversation.

capabilities: Reads supported local image files from the agent workspace
Optionally processes explicitly enabled remote image URLs
Sends selected images and prompts to a configured third-party vision provider
Supports OpenAI Responses, OpenAI Chat Completions, and Anthropic Messages API formats
Provides a vision_analyze tool and bridges images from the WebUI for text-only model routes
